new_program_source = '''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    nonzero = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(height) for c in range(width) if grid[r][c]]

    def stripe_groups(key_fn):
        groups = {}
        for r, c, value in nonzero:
            groups.setdefault(key_fn(r, c), set()).add(value)
        return groups

    orientations = [
        (lambda r, c: c - r),
        (lambda r, c: r + c),
    ]
    groups_by_orientation = [stripe_groups(key_fn) for key_fn in orientations]
    conflicts = [sum(len(colors) - 1 for colors in groups.values()) for groups in groups_by_orientation]
    chosen = min(range(2), key=lambda i: conflicts[i])
    key_fn = orientations[chosen]
    groups = groups_by_orientation[chosen]
    period = len(groups)
    colors_by_phase = {}
    for key, colors in groups.items():
        phase = key % period
        color = next(iter(colors))
        if phase in colors_by_phase and colors_by_phase[phase] != color:
            raise ValueError('inconsistent diagonal stripe pattern')
        colors_by_phase[phase] = color

    return [[colors_by_phase[key_fn(r, c) % period] for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
'''
program_path.write_text(new_program_source)
exec(compile(new_program_source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
# Verify demo 1 and demo 2.

print('demo1 and demo2 reproduced')
